description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of an IPv6 Translation Service instance
description_zh: 修改IPv6转换服务实例的带宽
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-translator-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000 --bandwidth 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIPv6TranslatorBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPv6 transform service
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_id

parameters.help_en: The peak bandwidth of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values: 1 to 200. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的带宽峰值，取值：1~200。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay the bill for the subscription instance. Valid values: 

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付预付费实例的账单，取值： 

true：是。

false（默认值）：否。
parameters.name: auto_pay
